subject.title: [Bug]: publishable plugin runtime builds cannot emit native CJS entrypoints

question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` as the package-build knob for publishing msteams with native `.cjs` runtime sidecars?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the available fix adds package build metadata and changes official installed-plugin startup artifacts, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive maintainer territory.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 is repaired/reviewed, then land it if the CJS package contract is accepted.

options.title: Keep the build surface ESM-only
options.body: Reject or revise the linked PR if maintainers decide publishable plugin runtime packages should not gain a CJS build mode now.

options.title: Choose another packaging design
options.body: Keep this issue open but replace `runtimeFormat` with the preferred internal packaging mechanism before publishing msteams artifacts.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 is repaired/reviewed, then land it if the CJS package contract is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the package-local npm runtime build path and are the strongest history signal for the package-build contract decision.
